title: Pharmacy?
content: I recently visited a pharmacy at mall world. I was with people who were my friends in the dream but didn’t know outside of there. Someone said “when the apocalypse happens, this is where I want to be,” and I agreed thinking they meant it hypothetically. But then they started barricading us in there and I was like it’s not the apocalypse right now, we don’t need to do this yet! Was this any of y’all? Or has anyone else been to the pharmacy? It was like CVS but more freezers and coolers
